what: The whole process of the R(3,10) lane in order: the control room’s rounds of 22 and 23 November (C35, Case R(7), Case R(6)), then the attack on 40 (rounds 1 to 5, 23 to 25 November) and the 41 side, every gate with its pass condition as written before the run (or the ledger’s words when it was sent in a message), its outcome as the control room ruled it, its key count and what it ruled out; and the sessions running at the records’ minute, read from their own run files. A checkpoint is the session’s own words, not a ruling.

rounds.plain: Claude, Astra and Grok each proposed five falsifiable ideas to settle or shrink R(3,10), to be tested on the complete small catalogues.
The participants read and attacked each other's round-1 ideas; survivors were re-checked by independent code and the dead ends recorded.
The lane aimed at R(3,10) = 40: make ten frozen 40-vertex SAT jobs finish with certificates, on the Mac only, nothing rented.
No pods: Astra looks for workarounds to settle 40, one line closing one whole board, another finding a route that avoids 4,443 board completions.
Test many paths, first where the truth is known; a path is dead only with its number and survives only after a second program reproduces it.
A side lane that searches for one (3,10;40)-graph, which would make R(3,10) = 41; every failed search still returns its nearest miss and certified exclusions.

gates.line: the control room (Claude A's glue, two encodings)
gates.condition: After the stage-1 sweep, glue the survivors in stage 2 with a second encoding and LRAT for every UNSAT; if all close, P66 is a theorem.
gates.count: 30 of 30 stage-2 survivors UNSAT, 60 LRAT proofs
gates.ruled_out: Stage 2 closed every (6,6) survivor; P66 still waited on a second independent stage-1 sweep before it could count.

gates.line: Astra, a fresh session with its own code (round3/astra-screen-check)
gates.condition: Astra's single-source trace-LP screen with 345 integer Farkas certificates must be re-checked by an independent program.
gates.ruled_out: The trace-LP screen now rests on two programs of the same model family; a Claude re-check was still owed before citing it.

gates.condition: At least 5 of the 10 frozen 40-vertex jobs end with a certified verdict within 2 CPU-hours each, with every stratum c* = 3, 4, 5 represented.
gates.ruled_out: Trace-partition cubes with lazy independent-10 cuts and Hall constraints do not close a board; nothing was rented.

gates.condition: Read the literature: how R(3,10) <= 41 was proved, the tables of minimum edge numbers, and which unproved bound would remove the most cases.
gates.count: needs 100 and 97 edges; true minima 86 and 95
gates.ruled_out: The edge-number route to 40 is dead; flag algebras and direct SAT above 28 vertices are dead by printed numbers.

gates.condition: One route that provably decides all remaining cases, with its first step run on the Mac and a projected total under 5,000 core-hours.
gates.count: 0 routes with a finite price; 563 hosts screened
gates.ruled_out: Enumerating the shared part of a pair is dead for the regular case: c = 6 alone costs over 70,000 CPU-hours.

gates.condition: A certified lemma that excludes a whole c* stratum of the 9-regular case, or prices it under 5,000 core-hours, with a control on a real graph.
gates.count: c* = 3 covered by 7 configurations; 0 of 7 closed
gates.ruled_out: No stratum excluded, but c* = 3 reduces to seven rooted configurations by a certified cover; degree counts alone miss triangle-freeness.

gates.condition: Every column the auditor regenerates with its own code must get a nonnegative coefficient under the claimant's fifteen multipliers, proving the seven-profile cover.
gates.ruled_out: The seven-configuration cover of c* = 3 now stands on two independent checks; none of the seven profiles is closed.

gates.condition: At least one of the ten pilot-2 boards certified excluded as a whole, every leaf's LRAT accepted by both checkers, with a checked cover proof.
gates.count: 1 board open after 13.9 CPU-hours; 242 leaves open
gates.ruled_out: Completing boards by SAT is dead at this lane's scale, with or without proof reuse across relabelled siblings.

gates.condition: Some method reaches the true R(3,k) for k = 7, 8, 9 with controls intact and excludes n = 41 at k = 10 within 10 CPU-hours, certified.
gates.count: 14 methods; all stop at 43 or worse at k = 10
gates.ruled_out: Single-root counting at any depth is dead: a phantom made of one real card fools it; agreement between two roots is the needed input.

gates.condition: A checked cover of the c* = 4 stratum by rooted configurations, its price by two programs, and at least one whole configuration closed with certificates.
gates.count: 9 of 69 profiles closed; 493 of 670 assignments open
gates.ruled_out: c* = 4 now stands as 69 six-row profiles with nine closed by readable arguments using exact small Ramsey numbers; the stratum is not excluded.

gates.condition: The auditor re-derives G7 by its own enumerators and hand checks, reading the claimant's proofs as text only, and rules G7 by the same gate.
gates.ruled_out: G7 stands on two derivations; elementary rules are exhausted at this level and per-placement SAT is not a seconds-instance.

gates.condition: In the ledger's words: the structure scout's four statements (tail law N13, pentagon integrality N15, one stratum's cores N14), tested by a second program.
gates.ruled_out: The tail law holds in every catalogue with its first rung a theorem; pentagon integrality and single-stratum core filters are dead.

gates.condition: In the ledger's words: exact identities tying the 60 cases over all codegree-4 pairs; PASS = infeasible, or a certified cover of at most 20 cases.
gates.ruled_out: Case-level counting across roots at c* = 4 is dead: its points are pair-level phantoms whose pairs never agree on triples.

gates.condition: In the ledger's words: every ingredient must keep the real 6-regular graphs on 22 vertices feasible and make (23, 6) infeasible without the catalogue below.
gates.count: closed only (23, 6) at cap 2; caps 3, 4 survive
gates.ruled_out: Ramsey-at-the-root, second-level edge counts and equality cases do not separate the twins; what is missing is that pairs agree on shared vertices.

gates.line: Astra D (round4/astra-nonregular), ruled by a Claude audit (round5/audit-nonregular)
gates.condition: At least 50 of the 355 degree distributions with at most two degree-6 vertices excluded, each by a certificate a second program re-checks, premises listed.
gates.ruled_out: Degree-class statistics are exhausted at this level; Chen's floor 88 is not confirmed; 291 distributions survive.

gates.condition: Mine the finished exclusions for their minimal reasons and turn them into a lemma.
gates.count: 0 lemmas survive; 655 of 655 explained by 5 screens
gates.ruled_out: Proof mining is dead: small reasons are already screens, and large refutations are diffuse across at least 8 core vertices.

gates.condition: In the ledger's words: the agreement of two crossing roots at (18, 5) as a finite check; if two roots embed, three.
gates.count: (18, 5) excluded at 0 roots; LRAT through both checkers
gates.ruled_out: The regular twin (18, 5) is excluded with no independence clause and no catalogue: what counting forgot is assembling the pairs into one graph.

gates.condition: In the ledger's words: audit the claimant's low-vertex lemmas; a bounded attempt at floor 88; one worked two-root example on the nearest survivors.
gates.ruled_out: The low-vertex lemmas L1 to L5 stand by hand; floor 88 at degree 9 is not established and not a small job.

gates.condition: In the ledger's words: match the published House of Graphs minimum-edge lists against the lists the floors used.
gates.count: 4 layers equal published lists; 26 of 355 on lists alone
gates.ruled_out: The degree-9 floor 87 rests wholly on a published list; no cheap exact route to the 4 missing 87-edge graphs.

gates.condition: A second ladder table built with the auditor's own programs, ruled by G9's own gate.
gates.count: G9 FAIL confirmed; one-level row corrected to 29 at k = 8
gates.ruled_out: Local counting collapses to mixtures of real cards; higher subgraph identities (row N12) are dead from k = 8 on.

gates.condition: A two-root system excludes the regular twins (7,23) and (6,18) with a checkable certificate and no catalogue below as input, and is evaluated at (10,40).
gates.ruled_out: The edge charge closes the twins by its letter, but it regenerates the census inside the verifier and is feasible at 40.

gates.condition: In the ledger's words: an audit of G10 with own proofs from SYSTEM.md as text, its own enumeration, and the claimant's verifier run in an empty directory.
gates.ruled_out: The edge charge (row N24) is dead as a route to 40: genuine two-root charts of both signs exist there.

gates.condition: Local inequalities proved by SAT on boards with two or three marks fixed, summed by double counting in an LP, must close the twins and then 40.
gates.ruled_out: SAT-proved rows summed by an LP are dead at 40 in this form: the rows needed are false one vertex below and cost the whole problem.

gates.condition: KEEP if all three tail roots are UNSAT at (8,28) at half the pair board's cost or less; CLOSE if they cost as much; UNDECIDED if nothing finishes.
gates.count: 0 of 4 runs finished within 1,343 CPU-s each
gates.ruled_out: The tail law stays a fact about the catalogues; as a root for search it is not pursued, its cost grew 290 times from 18 to 23.

gates.condition: In the ledger's words: hunt a card at 40 on which fractional gluing is feasible (then dead) or extract a uniform inequality that holds at all three levels.
gates.ruled_out: No feasible card was found and no fixed inequality excludes every card; only the per-card LP itself holds everywhere.

gates.condition: In the ledger's words: decide W(40, 9, 3) and W(40, 9, 4); a witness is the first 40-vertex control, a checked UNSAT excludes the stratum.
gates.count: 2 of 2 windows non-empty (cap 4 and cap 3 witnesses)
gates.ruled_out: No argument made only of degrees, triangles and codegrees can close c* = 3 or c* = 4; only independent 10-sets can.

gates.condition: In the ledger's words: rerun the twin table with the two maximum-independent-set rows (n1 <= d; at most three vertices with trace inside a pair).
gates.ruled_out: The two maximum-independent-set rows are true but do not separate the twins; row N23 is dead as a separator.

gates.line: a Claude agent (round5/c4-claude; first run in round5/rows-sat)
gates.condition: Restrict a counting LP at 40 to what occurs on the 39-vertex graphs; if it stays feasible, the LP is dead before any SAT is spent.
gates.ruled_out: Both counting systems tried, the simple pair LP and the c* = 4 pair system, are dead before any SAT is spent on them.

gates.condition: PASS(1) when one whole profile of the seven c* = 3 configurations is excluded with certified refutations and a twice-generated enumeration; PASS(7) when all are.
gates.ruled_out: Closing the seven c* = 3 profiles by local structure is not pursued: four occur in a real 40-vertex graph with the same local structure.

gates.condition: PASS DEAD if a residual at 40 is exactly feasible; PASS UNIFORM if every sampled residual is exactly infeasible and one inequality excludes them all.
gates.count: 0 of 9,182 hosts feasible; no single inequality
gates.ruled_out: Part 1 holds in exact arithmetic on 9,182 hosts; the claimed uniform inequality is the LP's dual, not one fixed inequality.

gates.condition: In the ledger's words: a local search inside the cap-3 window minimising the number of independent 10-sets (a window graph with none is a (3,10;40)-graph).
gates.ruled_out: The cap-3 window looks rigid (one graph seen); local search inside it cannot move, which led to classifying W(40,9,3).

gates.condition: Measure how many good vertices (in no independent 10-set) a 9-regular triangle-free 40-vertex graph can have, and look for an upper bound below 40.
gates.ruled_out: No argument caps the number of good vertices; the cliff seen at the twins is not general (11 of 28 exist).

gates.line: the control room (a Claude agent drove the pod)
gates.condition: A second, independent stage-1 sweep of all 477,142 (3,8;27)-graphs must agree with the first on every line.
gates.ruled_out: P66 is now computed twice at every stage (its reduction still prose); with it 273 of 519 non-regular distributions are excluded.

gates.condition: In the ledger's words: the adversary ported to C, at least 10^5 distinct cards; PASS DEAD needs an exactly feasible card, PASS FLOOR the floor's histogram.
gates.ruled_out: A larger sample near known graphs is not continued; the question that decides the lead is the transfer rate (G20).

gates.condition: At least 7 more of the 281 surviving degree profiles excluded, each by a certificate a second, differently written program re-checks, premises listed, controls intact.
gates.ruled_out: Three degree-6 vertices are impossible (n6 <= 2) without P66; 246 distributions survive.

gates.condition: At least 30 of the 60 open c* = 4 profiles closed entirely by Ramsey pressure with equality cases, each with a replayable certificate, controls intact.
gates.ruled_out: Ramsey pressure with catalogue equality cases closes no whole c* = 4 profile, and its closure fraction falls at c* = 5 and 6.

gates.condition: In the ledger's words: classify W(40,9,3), with the tightness calibration, the algebra (an eigenvalue bound for every member) and the enumeration.
gates.count: 1 graph in every probe; not classified
gates.ruled_out: No eigenvalue argument forces an independent 10-set; the window's count collapses as tightness rises.

gates.condition: At least one more symmetry class of W(40,9,3) decided completely with proofs through both checkers, a checked completeness argument and calibration intact.
gates.ruled_out: No 9-regular (3,10;40)-graph with largest codegree 3 has an automorphism of cycle type 10^4, 5^8, 8^5 or 4^10.

gates.condition: A dictionary of at most 200 fixed obstructions, none in a control, excludes at least 90% of at least 2,000 fresh held-out hosts.
gates.ruled_out: The per-card gluing test has no small finite cause: the typical obstruction covers one host, so as a route it is the census again.

gates.condition: Re-derive G16's claims, frozen from the report's text before any claimant program was opened, by the auditor's own routes.
gates.ruled_out: At most two degree-6 vertices is now a theorem on two programs; n6 <= 2 has two distinct routes (P66 and the three-lows theorem).

gates.condition: All four symmetry classes of W1 come out the same with the second program's own proofs and completeness checks, and the calibration holds.
gates.ruled_out: W1 is on two programs and cited: types 10^4, 5^8, 8^5, 4^10 are excluded for a codegree-3 9-regular (3,10;40)-graph.

gates.condition: The finite-n sum-of-squares hierarchy closes the twin (7,23), or anything harder, with a checkable certificate and the controls intact.
gates.ruled_out: The finite-n sum-of-squares ladder (row N11) is dead for 40: it fails the twin (7,23), and level 10 is beyond the Mac.

gates.condition: In the ledger's words: lower bounds on the independence number of triangle-free graphs (Shearer) at 40 vertices, degree 9; the proof needs alpha >= 10.
gates.ruled_out: The probabilistic method cannot reach 40: Shearer-type bounds give 7.85 at degree 9, more than 2 short.

gates.condition: W(40,9,3) = {G} by the asymmetric split with proofs and completeness checks, calibration intact; PARTIAL if 2^20 and prime types close and the split is counted.
gates.count: 2^20 down to 1 sub-part; asymmetric split uncounted
gates.ruled_out: Any member of W(40,9,3) other than G has |Aut| = 2^i 3^j: no automorphism of prime order 7 or at least 11, and order 5 forces G.

gates.line: a Claude agent with web access (lane41 scout)
gates.condition: Scout who searched for a (3,10;40)-graph and how, which near misses are published, and which classes are already excluded.
gates.count: done in 15 searches; 2 classes open in print
gates.ruled_out: Extending known 39-vertex graphs and circulants are already published and negative; A2 was redirected to the open classes 2^20 and 5^8.

gates.condition: PASS if the 2K_2 theorem is confirmed and every placement refuted (c* = 4 excluded); PARTIAL if confirmed and some placements refuted.
gates.ruled_out: The 2K_2 theorem stands on two derivations; placement with one- and two-point cards is dead as stated, a real 40-vertex graph satisfies them.

gates.condition: Some potential and move family of bounded size has zero local maxima on every complete catalogue tested, with the controls intact.
gates.ruled_out: Row N16 as a bounded-move switching monovariant is dead: six (3,7;22)-graphs cannot reach a maximum-edge member.

gates.condition: At least 10 more of the 246 surviving keys excluded, each by a certificate a differently written second program re-checks, premises listed, controls intact.
gates.ruled_out: One key, (0,16,0,24), falls by agreement between views (single-source then); removing the single-root floors gives zero new keys.

gates.condition: Run every edge move up to r = 4 on the six closed (3,7;22)-graphs to find the smallest move size that frees them.
gates.ruled_out: The bounded-move monovariant stays dead through r = 4 on (3,7;22).

gates.condition: At least 5 more of the 35 keys with two degree-6 vertices excluded, each search cross-checked against brute force, premises listed, controls intact.
gates.ruled_out: The tight adjacent case has no 27-vertex frame, so the shore search cannot close it as built.

gates.condition: At least one of the seven tight keys excluded in full, both the adjacent and the non-adjacent case, with the same checks.
gates.ruled_out: A frame from a degree-7 double is never forced; closing it would need a new lemma or unpublished (3,8;25)/(3,8;26) lists.

gates.condition: The key (2,6,2,30) excluded in full, after proving its adjacent tight case forces a degree-7 double.
gates.count: 0 of 1 key; forcing neither proved nor refuted
gates.ruled_out: Three gates in a row ended with 'not forced'; the line on keys with two degree-6 vertices is parked.

gates.condition: The key (0,4,28,8) excluded with a certificate a second program written differently re-checks, premises listed, controls intact.
gates.ruled_out: (0,4,28,8) is impossible: no exterior in the complete 32/108 layer passes the dominating-set test (single-source until AUD-2).

gates.condition: A (3,10;40)-graph is found and verified by two independent alpha programs and a triangle check.
gates.ruled_out: No 39-vertex graph on disk extends by one vertex, and no Cayley graph of order 40 is a (3,10;40)-graph, both with LRAT.

gates.condition: The involution type 2^20 and every admissible prime-order type with at most 10 fixed points decided, each as {G} or empty, with certificates.
gates.ruled_out: Apart from G, every member of W(40,9,3) has only primes 2 and possibly 3 in its automorphism group; involutions are the remaining core.

gates.condition: At least one of the 9-regular classes 5^8 or 2^20 decided at 40, by certified UNSAT or a verified witness, with calibrations K1 to K3 passing.
gates.count: K1 not found in 2 runs of 600 s
gates.ruled_out: The symmetric-SAT line at 40 is parked: the engine cannot find the known 35-vertex graph, so the 40-vertex classes were not run.

gates.condition: The degree-7 floor f7 >= 109 proved by a certificate a second, differently written program re-checks, with a planted positive control.
gates.ruled_out: A degree-7 vertex's exterior has at least 109 edges; the relaxed cover fails on all 2,104,151 cards of the 32/108 layer.

gates.condition: Decide (22,6,3) and (23,6,3) in full and count the asymmetric split at (40,9,3) with two programs.
gates.count: at least 119,753 configurations; at least 298 core-hours
gates.ruled_out: Classifying the asymmetric case of W(40,9,3) by these splits is a census and is parked; W(23,6,3) has 91 classes, 28 new.

gates.condition: Re-derive Astra D's single-source exclusions (G22, G24, then G27's floor) with the auditor's own code, claims frozen from the text before any claimant program.
gates.count: 2 of 3 claims confirmed; G22 still single-source
gates.ruled_out: G24 and G27 (9 keys) now rest on two programs; G22's (0,16,0,24) had 362 templates undecided.

gates.condition: The degree-7 floor f7 >= 110 proved by a certificate a second, differently written program re-checks, controls intact.
gates.ruled_out: The degree-four branch of the 32/109 layer is closed; edge-critical cards of minimum degree 5 or 6 stay open.

gates.condition: Decide 2^20 in full: every member of W(40,9,3) invariant under a fixed-point-free involution is G, with certificates.
gates.ruled_out: The branches with 0, 12, 14, 16, 18 and 20 internal fibres are empty; branches 2 to 10 stay open.

gates.condition: Finish claim A, the key (0,16,0,24), on its 362 undecided templates with the per-high row bound added as clauses, controls first.
gates.ruled_out: All but one template of (0,16,0,24) are excluded by a second program; template 9518 remains.

gates.condition: f7 >= 110 proved: every critical card of minimum degree 5 or 6 excluded and the deletable-edge half re-checked to its end, by a second program.
gates.ruled_out: The deletable-edge branch of 32/109 is closed by two programs; the requested matching test does not separate the root types.

gates.condition: Decide the last template 9518 with the AUD-2b configuration in one run, capped at 2 core-hours, cubing it if unfinished.
gates.ruled_out: G22's (0,16,0,24) rests on two programs; all ten keys beyond G16's 273 are now re-derived by a second program.

gates.condition: Decide 2^20 in full: every member of W(40,9,3) invariant under a fixed-point-free involution is G, with certificates.
gates.ruled_out: The 2- and 4-internal-fibre branches are empty and skeleton 8 is closed; three branches stay open.

gates.condition: Decide 2^20 in full: every member of W(40,9,3) invariant under a fixed-point-free involution is G, with certificates.
gates.ruled_out: No 9-regular (3,10;40)-graph with largest codegree 3 has a fixed-point-free involution; types 2^19 1^2 to 2^17 1^6 stay open.

gates.condition: f7 >= 110 proved, every open root type excluded, with certificates a differently written second program re-checks, controls intact.
gates.ruled_out: The exact trace test by König closes ten more root types but no key; 283 of 519 stand.

gates.condition: Decide the involution type 2^19 1^2 of the cap-3 window in full: every member with such an automorphism identified, or none exists, with LRAT through both checkers.
gates.ruled_out: No member of the cap-3 window has an involution fixing exactly two vertices; open involution types: 2^18 1^4 and 2^17 1^6.

running.condition: PASS when f7 >= 110 is proved (every open root type excluded) with certificates a second program written differently re-checks, premises listed, controls intact
PASS when 2^18 1^4 is decided in full, both cases (every member with such an automorphism identified, or none exists) with the certification above
